## Sri Lanka Dengue Situation in 2026 (up to Week 43, 2026)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 150%
#| out-height: 1500px

# LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(denguedatahub)
# pak::pak("thiyangt/ceylon")
library(ceylon)
library(stringdist)
library(viridis)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(jsonlite)
library(leafsync)

# District counts 2026 43
district <- read_excel("dataraw/District.xlsx", sheet=1)
# MOH Counts
MOH <- read_csv("dataraw/MOH.csv")
# MOH longitude and latitude
sri_lanka_areas_coordinates <- read_csv("dataraw/sri_lanka_areas_coordinates.csv")

###########################################################
# ============================================================
# Dengue maps for Sri Lanka, 2026
#   Map (a): district counts (district name + count shown)
#   Map (b): high-risk MOH areas (points coloured by total
#            cases, name shown)
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(stringdist)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(leafsync)
library(ceylon)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. READ DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
district <- read_excel("dataraw/District.xlsx", sheet = 1)
MOH      <- read_csv("dataraw/MOH.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
coords   <- read_csv("dataraw/sri_lanka_areas_coordinates.csv",
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

district2026 <- district |>
  filter(year == 2026) |>
  select(district, annual_cases) |>
  mutate(district_clean = toupper(trimws(district)))

week_up_to <- district |>
  filter(year == 2026) |>
  pull(`Up to week`) |>
  max(na.rm = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DISTRICT POLYGONS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# District boundaries from the ceylon package.
# If your boundary object has a different name, change it here.
polys <- ceylon::district |> st_as_sf() |> st_transform(4326)

# Find the column that holds the district names automatically:
# the character column that best overlaps with our district names
char_cols <- names(polys)[sapply(polys, is.character)]
overlap <- sapply(char_cols, function(cl) {
  sum(toupper(trimws(polys[[cl]])) %in% district2026$district_clean)
})
name_col <- char_cols[which.max(overlap)]

polys <- polys |>
  mutate(DISTRICT_clean = toupper(trimws(.data[[name_col]])))

# Fuzzy match the Excel district names to the polygon names
district2026 <- district2026 |>
  mutate(
    DISTRICT_match = polys$DISTRICT_clean[
      amatch(district_clean, polys$DISTRICT_clean, maxDist = 3)
    ]
  )

district_sf <- polys |>
  left_join(district2026, by = c("DISTRICT_clean" = "DISTRICT_match")) |>
  filter(!is.na(annual_cases))

# Label points inside each polygon
district_pts <- st_point_on_surface(district_sf)
district_sf$lab_lng <- st_coordinates(district_pts)[, 1]
district_sf$lab_lat <- st_coordinates(district_pts)[, 2]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. MAP (a): DISTRICT COUNTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
district_pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", district_sf$annual_cases,
                             na.color = "white")

map_height <- 800   # increase/decrease to resize both maps
map_width <- 1000

map1 <- leaflet(district_sf, height = map_height, width = map_width) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addControl(
    htmltools::tags$div("(a)", style = "font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;
      background:white; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:4px;"),
    position = "topleft"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor   = ~district_pal(annual_cases),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color       = "white",
    weight      = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "blue",
                                        bringToFront = TRUE)
  ) |>
  # Permanent labels: district name + count
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = ~lab_lng, lat = ~lab_lat,
    label = ~paste0(district, ": ", format(annual_cases, big.mark = ",")),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE, direction = "center", textOnly = TRUE,
      style = list("font-size" = "10px", "font-weight" = "bold",
                   "color" = "black", "text-shadow" = "0 0 3px white")
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright", pal = district_pal,
    values = ~annual_cases,
    title = paste0("Dengue cases<br>2026 (up to wk ", week_up_to, ")"),
    opacity = 1
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MOH AREAS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
coords <- coords |> rename(HighRiskMOHAreas = area)

moh2026 <- MOH |>
  filter(Year == 2026) |>
  left_join(coords, by = "HighRiskMOHAreas") |>
  filter(is.finite(longitude), is.finite(latitude), !is.na(Cases)) |>
  group_by(HighRiskMOHAreas, District, longitude, latitude) |>
  summarise(Cases = sum(as.numeric(Cases), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. MAP (b): HIGH-RISK MOH AREAS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
moh_pal <- colorNumeric("YlGnBu", moh2026$Cases, na.color = "grey")

map2 <- leaflet(moh2026, height = map_height, width = map_width) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addControl(
    htmltools::tags$div("(b)", style = "font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;
      background:white; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:4px;"),
    position = "topleft"
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude,
    radius      = 7,
    color       = "white",
    weight      = 1.5,
    fillColor   = ~moh_pal(Cases),
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    # Name shown only on mouse hover
    label = ~HighRiskMOHAreas,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-size" = "13px", "font-weight" = "bold")
    ),
    popup = ~paste0("<b>MOH area:</b> ", HighRiskMOHAreas,
                    "<br><b>District:</b> ", District,
                    "<br><b>Total cases (2026):</b> ",
                    format(Cases, big.mark = ","))
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright", pal = moh_pal, values = ~Cases,
    title = paste0("High-risk MOH<br>total cases 2026"),
    opacity = 1
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. SHOW SIDE BY SIDE (zoom/pan linked) AND SAVE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sri_lanka_view <- function(m) {
  m |> setView(lng = 80.7, lat = 7.8, zoom = 10)
}
map1 <- sri_lanka_view(map1)
map2 <- sri_lanka_view(map2)

both <- leafsync::sync(map1, map2, ncol = 2)
both

htmltools::save_html(both, "dengue_maps_2026.html")

```
